name: Slow Growing Subdivision Connectivity
definition: A refinement scheme for volumetric meshes that generalizes Catmull-Clark rules into three distinct steps (tiers) labeled 0 to 3, where (level, 3) is equivalent to (level + 1, 0).
summary: Slow Growing Subdivision Connectivity is a purely topological, deterministic refinement scheme that generalizes Catmull-Clark rules via multi-tier factorization, unlike geometric methods such as Longest Edge Bisection.
